name: SONAT South Sys Expansion II Phase 3
researcher_notes: The Aug 2026 EIA release lists this project on the Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 327, not the current projects sheet. It is marked Completed, in service May 2004, 46.4 mi of 20 inch pipe, 138 MMcf/d added, in Alabama and Georgia, FERC docket CP02-01, operator Southern Natural Gas Co. It is an old expansion that has been part of the operating Southern Natural Gas system for over 20 years, so it is already inside the existing system row P0252 (operating, start 1928). The tracker's other row for this operator, P7855, is a different proposed project. It is not a new project, so no new row is proposed. No second source was checked. Sibling phases (Phase 1, 1A, 2 of the same docket, South System Expansion III phases 1 to 3) are also completed historical rows and fall under the same conclusion.
